scene: The magnetic boots lock on, snapping you straight up onto the ceiling.
picture: A flat side view along the ceiling floorline. The girl stands centre upside down in chunky boots with her sketchbook. Far left hangs a glowing geometric tapestry. Right of centre, a mustachioed visitor in a bowler hat sips tea. At far right, a round brass hatch is shut tight on the floor.
shown: a vast glowing tapestry hanging flat at the far left
a mustachioed visitor in a bowler hat standing right of centre
an arched ceiling hatch standing closed at the far right

variants.scene: Your boots clank into place, flipping you neatly onto the grand tiled ceiling.
You click upside down, your sketchbook safe as people stroll far below you.
Magnets hum underfoot while you search above the hall for {quest}.
